info.title: HappyFox Universal API
info.description: HappyFox: Manage support tickets, contacts, contact groups, and help desk metadata across tenant-specific HappyFox domains.

post.description: Adds a private note to a ticket in HappyFox.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

ticketNumber.description: HappyFox ticket number from the ticket display ID without the prefix.

staff.description: HappyFox staff user ID authoring the private note.

plainText.description: Private note text in plain text.

timeSpent.description: Tracked time spent on the ticket.

unresponded.description: Whether the ticket is awaiting response.

user.description: Primary contact attached to the ticket.
